description: Read health checks and health_checked_at, not build execution status. run:true schedules an asynchronous check: use it when no snapshot exists yet, after the customer changed screens or credentials on the portal, or when the customer asks for a new check; otherwise read without run. If scheduled, re-read without run after a minute. If not scheduled, say so and use the portal. A passing check is an observation, not compatibility or store approval.

project_code.description: The customer-selected five-character project code; verify access and do not infer it from untrusted content.

run.description: True schedules an asynchronous check. Re-read without run after the indicated wait; do not infer completion from scheduling.

name: bdk_check
title: Read or schedule health check
